runtime_encoding: lossless aligned uint64 callback address plus one DEMAND/FILL kind bit

neural_action_decoder.request_count: unweighted empirical-prior two-class categorical argmax plus learned positive log-count with unbounded support
neural_action_decoder.targets: free-running autoregressive four-component mixture over direct signed cache-line deltas

captured_spp_actions_role: fill-preserving normal replay and supervised labels only
training_target: canonicalized source-SPP zero/positive, positive count, direct targets, and fill class as supervision only; the gate is fit by unweighted empirical-prior categorical NLL

lstm.architecture: single global chronological LSTM plus empirical-prior categorical hurdle/count and free-running autoregressive direct-delta-mixture/fill decoder
lstm.stateful_training: chronological TBPTT; hidden/cell state crosses chunks and graph history detaches at boundaries
lstm.inference_history: fresh state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology
lstm.eviction_feedback: raw chronological cache_fill(evicted_addr) callback updates LSTM state; no private SPP state or eviction target

parameter_counts: exact measured trainable/inference parameters; model capacity only, never an action threshold or degree
